title: TRex: free TextSniper alternative
caption:
TextSniper charges $7.99. TRex copies text off your screen for free 🦖

✅ Draw a box on your screen, the text lands in your clipboard
✅ Reads QR codes and barcodes too
✅ Works offline with a shortcut you set
✅ No subscription, no retyping, free from GitHub

💻 Mac (macOS 11 Big Sur and up)
ℹ️ The free download is on GitHub and Homebrew. The Mac App Store version is a paid listing. TextSniper price is its one-time single-Mac license

Comment "TEXT" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
